## Question 1

```{python}
import numpy as np 
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

myList = [1,2,3,4] # secondary list 

mixed = [1,2,True,"blue", myList] #primary mixed list
mixed

#extract third element

third = mixed[2] #pull third element
print(third)

listWithinList = mixed[4][2] #pull third element of fourth element
print(listWithinList)

mixed.append(7) #add an element
print(mixed)

mixed.remove(7) #remove an element
print(mixed)

mixed.clear() # clear the whole situation 
print(mixed)

```


## Question 2

```{python}
md = {
    "first":"Bryan",
    "last" : "Wilcenski",
    "year" : 2002,
    "status": "active",
    "coding" : "yes"
}


keys = md.keys() #extract the keys 
print(keys)

values = md.values() #extract the values
print(values)

md.get("last") # "md.get(x) extracts the value associated with the key "x". 

md.items() # md.items() ceates a list of touples containing all keys and their associated values

del md["coding"] #remove the coding key and value 
md


```


## Question 3

```{python}
import numpy as np 
from numpy import random


arr1 = random.rand(100) #create list of random numbers between 0 and 1 - 100 long

arr1[-10:] #extract last ten numbers in array 

arr1.astype(str) #convert to strings

arr1.astype(float) #convert back to float



arr2D= arr1.reshape(10,10) #reshape to 10 by 10 array
print(arr2D)

arr_bin = random.choice([0,1], p = [.8,.2],size= (10,10)) # create binary array  with probability of 1s and 0s 

newStack= np.stack((arr2D, arr_bin)) #stack two arrays on top of eachother 
print(newStack)


```
